title: Aromatic Light Kenyan Meat Bake
description: A malty and light Kenyan dish featuring sesame seed oil, this bake is a perfect blend of adventurous flavors, keto-friendly and cooked to perfection in a dolsot-stone-bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame seed oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the ground beef is browned, add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a dolsot-stone-bowl and stir in the malt extract.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
